questions.prompt: Why write units through each calculation?
questions.answer: They reveal whether conversions and relationships are dimensionally consistent.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: How many cm² are in one m²?
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.prompt: Is a change from 10% to 15% a 5% relative increase?
questions.answer: No; it is five percentage points or a 50% relative increase.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Calculates rates, conversions and percentage comparisons with correct units.
scoring.transfer: Create three conversion problems involving length, area and a rate. Include one intentionally incorrect solution and explain which check exposes it.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
